text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye safely powered through her third year's summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...!
What a sense of accomplishment!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she's completely recovered from the race's fatigue.
Even after all that intense training!
choice_data_list: It's 'cause I knew when to push and when to hold back
It's because I made sure to balance things out properly

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu, indeed! It's all thanks to your guidance.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
With this, I can take on the Tenno Sho (Autumn)――
at my absolute strongest!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer.
We still have some time before we have to head back, right?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Wanna go on a little walk?
Blast told me about this really pretty place!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
âLook, isn't it amazing!
You can see so far into the distance!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Beyond this ocean, there are so many more races out there, aren't there?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Someday, I'll go too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not "I want to go," but "I will go"—
It's just that "now" isn't the time yet.
Her mind is already completely made up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, there were voices asking, 'Isn't she going to take on the world?'
Even so, I held off on asking until it came from her own mouth—
choice_data_list: —I can't wait to see you win on the world stage, too!
—I can't wait to see you win on the world stage, too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes, me too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's get on the bus—ah.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Go on ahead, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Kiseki-chan!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Were you drawing manga?
...Oh my, but it's completely blank.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah, mm... a little, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Will you show me once it's done?
Your manga is so thrilling.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Just like your race!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup was truly thrilling! And you were so strong in the Osaka Hai, too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“—Yes, it was so thrilling!
That's why... winning felt completely different.”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
If I can beat someone as unpredictable as you—
I felt like I could do anything!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki-chan.
Make sure you excite me at the Tenno Sho (Autumn), too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Your eyes...
they've always been so dazzling to me.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...Geez, saying things like that again—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You are the protagonist.
I get that now... but still.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Why are you
shining so brightly?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I want to know.
The reason why your story shines so brightly...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Kiseki-chan...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "...I'm not a creator, so I don't know what you're feeling."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: So――anyway, let's run!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Were you able to have a good long talk?
Did you get to talk properly?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Now I'm looking forward to the race even more!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Autumn)...
I wonder what kind of joy awaits us there!"
choice_data_list: Ah... I'm looking forward to it.
Yeah...—I'm really looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye's eyes are always shining bright.
—And just like that, the summer training camp came to an end.
